title: Say in the reviewer prompt that the harness may start the reviewer in plan mode and that the report then goes in the final message

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261117-233556-f24d, project ork, item S388:

Say in the reviewer prompt that the harness may start the reviewer in plan mode and that the report then goes in the final message
